expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no registered bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective.

failure_modes: A pair-kernel contrast cannot be expressed by the executing pointcloud scalar, so any edit aimed at it would be inoperative.
Selecting a region_index from mixed-sign landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts risks unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates without a defensible expected affinity advantage.
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity would overstate benefit.
Treating turnover residuals or joint-motion covariance diagnostics as causal affinity effects would misattribute accounting or descriptive associations.
A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit without a validated absolute contrast would impose an unsupported time-conditioned rule.

parameter_origins.pointcloud_delta_A: incumbent default 1.0 A; executing curvature per formula_registry
parameter_origins.teacher_neighbors: incumbent 4; k is a count per formula_registry

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are the short-range pair kernels (endpoint_effects:9/10/11, positive_batch_fraction 1.0; branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241), but the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that contrast. Landmark softmin/occupancy and shape contrasts are mixed in sign across landmarks (endpoint_effects:14/15/16, endpoint_effects:4), so no single region_index is defensibly favored. Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; clocks; lineage_support; limitations), so it cannot justify a region or temporal edit. Increment contrasts disagree in direction with whole-window endpoint contrasts (increment_effects:14/15/3/4/7), and turnover residuals are descriptive accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/224/227/254/257/497/524/584). Observed-node curves show sign and rate changes with extrapolation_allowed false and legendre_runtime_allowed false (continuous:0/1; continuous_functions; curve_support), so a constant rule is not supported over a time-conditioned rule, but no validated absolute contrast identifies a specific temporal_region_index or blend. Joint-motion diagnostics are negative and reproducible (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153/228/230/305/307) but are adjusted covariance/correlation diagnostics, not a causal affinity benefit. The information audit's nearest-teacher excess distance is nonnegative by construction and not the full score-weighted reward (information_audit), and teacher modes are static last-learning-node forecasts with temperature_edits false (teacher_modes). Global centroid contrasts are null (branch_adjusted:0/1/2/77/78/79/154/155/156). Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (fixed_parameters). No registered bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, so retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; evidence that would change this decision is a validated absolute contrast identifying a specific landmark region or time-conditioned blend, or a decoded terminal-label evaluation showing a reproducible affinity benefit.
